concept.title: What's the difference between a Team Number and a Team Name?
concept.shortdesc: A team always will have both a team number and a team name, and the two are different!

conbody.p: A team name can be just the school's name, like Davis Senior High School, or the school's name plus a suffix, like Milpitas Blue. Sometimes a team can have fun with it (Castro Valley Garlic) and sometimes they can go the opposite direction (American Legion A). The team name is what will be announced at awards, but the team number is assigned to them when they register. This is to make it easier for the graders on their end, to put the tests in team order, and to be able to reference tests easier. It also allows for ease of attendance when finding out who actually showed up to each event.
